find: unlocked >= total ? 'Every level cleared.' : 'Clear a level to add it here.';
replace: 'Clear a level to add it here.';
why: Removes the completion signal, which is the thing issue #555 had to REPLACE rather than merely delete. A grid of locked buttons told a player implicitly that the campaign had an end and where it was; a grid that only grows says nothing, so a player who has cleared everything cannot tell that from a player whose next level has not arrived -- and this line promising another one is then a lie for the rest of the campaign, which under the cleared-only rule means for a player who has actually finished the game. Survives every population assertion in the file, because it changes no button.
killedBy: hud: level select panel says whether the grid will keep growing, without saying how far it has to go
